stationScope.evidence: The current official Stadtwerke Energie page explicitly states that its own public charging-point identifiers begin with DEJEN or DEJOB and publishes own-network prices separately from ladenetz.de roaming. From 2026-01-01 the own-network card tariff is 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC.

roamingDeferred.reason: Partner ladenetz.de prices are separate eMSP terms and must never be propagated to third-party physical CPOs.

note: Monthly base fee is 3.00 EUR and one-time card provision is 5.00 EUR; electricity customers receive the monthly base fee back. The official blocking fee is known (0.10 EUR/min after 240 min AC or 90 min DC, max 12 EUR/session, suspended 22:00-06:00; no blocking fee at Stadtwerke Energie lantern chargers from 2026-01-01) but is intentionally not encoded here because the current V9 direct-offer runtime has no validated representation for the night suspension plus lantern-charger exemption. Keep this CPO partial/fail-closed for that component.
